input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: Built a whole xlsx writer (xlsx.mjs + zip.mjs) on a stale origin/main before noticing #18769 had landed the same feature; threw it away and rebuilt only the missing parts on top of workbook.mjs. Cost roughly a third of the run.

The first draft of the LibreOffice recalc test could not catch a swapped work/stored rate cell or sub-cent rounding (every case had equal rates, and the CSV export rounded to the displayed value). Found by mutation testing and fixed before the PR.

The template page's meta description ran over 160 characters and failed platform/pages/description-length.test.mjs in CI. The local preflight would have caught it, but it stopped early on main's own failures and I only ran the venture tests plus build/check. Fixed in a follow-up commit.

doc_friction.issue: 'Duplicate PRs' says search open PRs and recent main commits before opening a PR. That is too late: the local origin/main ref from the clone was hours stale, and the duplicate (#18769) had merged in the meantime. Fetch origin main (git fetch --depth=40 origin main) and grep its log for the slug at the start of the run, not only before opening the PR.

Says to attach private-monorepo with add_repo and build there. add_repo succeeded, but the auto-mode classifier refused the git clone as unauthorized access, so the bet's private code was out of reach and the run fell back to the public side.

Stops before the build when main_health fails on main itself (test_scan.py guard order, stale transition.json), so a venture change can't get its build check from preflight while main is red. It also said 'this branch edits platform/ci' because origin/main was stale. I ran build.mjs + check.mjs by hand instead.

Because preflight halts at repository checks when main is red, the platform/pages site tests (step 1c) never run either. A per-page rule (meta description <= 160 chars) reached CI uncaught. Running the site tests even when main_health fails would help.

deviations.why: An overlapping open PR (#18775, Excel import into the same tool) touches the same files.
deviations.did: Opened a separate PR anyway: that one reads Excel in, mine adds a test and a landing page, so the scopes are complementary. Whichever lands second merges main.
deviations.result: PR opened; conflicts possible in index.html/README/llms.txt/page.test.mjs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an engineer writing a LibreOffice round-trip test with mutation checks, plus an SEO landing page and post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
